credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/rose.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LUNGING: the open dog rose thrust at the foe on an arching cane, a prickled cane arm forward, the rear cane arched back carrying two hips (the tail). Gesture: the bloom draws back cupped, thrusts with its petals flaring, holds, a glint gleams, settle. Sport: 'Persian Yellow'.
